column6: We do not accept conditional compilation branches inside command logic.
column7: Platform differences live behind the platform module and nowhere else.
column8: We add a runtime dependency only when the default command set uses it.
column9: A dependency that exists for one platform, one flag, or one benchmark is a dependency the whole project carries.
column10: I would rather be thirty percent slower everywhere than fast on one platform and unreviewable on the others.
column11: If you need one, the right change is to widen the platform module's interface so that every platform answers the same question, and then call it from the command like everybody else.
column12: If you can get the same win through the platform module so that all four targets go through it, I will merge that the day it lands.
column13: If a branch exists here that I cannot exercise, it will rot, and the way I will find out is a bug report from somebody who trusted a manifest.
